title: Simulating Step Response of RC Circuits Using PySpice

questions.q: What is the complete step response of an RC circuit?
questions.a: It is the sum of the natural response and forced response when an RC circuit with initial capacitor voltage V_0 is subjected to a sudden DC source change: V_C(t) = V_inf + (V_0 - V_inf) * e^(-t/tau).

questions.q: Why does the capacitor voltage settle at 20 V instead of 40 V before switching in Experiment 5?
questions.a: Because R1 (10 kΩ) and R2 (10 kΩ) form an equal voltage divider across V1 (40 V), so the Thevenin voltage seen by C1 is 40 V * (10k / 20k) = 20 V.

questions.q: How is the final steady-state voltage V_inf = -60 V obtained in Experiment 5?
questions.a: V2 (75 V) has its positive terminal at GND and negative at Node 3, so V(3) = -75 V. With C1 open-circuited in steady state, R4 (200 kΩ) and R5 (50 kΩ) divide -75 V to give V(4) = -75 * (200k / 250k) = -60 V.

questions.q: What is the post-switching equivalent resistance R_eq in Experiment 5?
questions.a: Looking from C1 into S2 after switching, R_eq = R3 + (R4 || R5) = 160 kΩ + (200k * 50k)/(200k + 50k) = 160 kΩ + 40 kΩ = 200 kΩ.

questions.q: At what time does the switch transition occur in Experiment 5?
How is V2's inverted polarity written in PySpice for Experiment 5?
questions.a: `circuit.V(2, circuit.gnd, 3, 75@u_V)` — placing `circuit.gnd` as the positive node and `3` as the negative node.

questions.q: What is the pre-switching Thevenin resistance and time constant in Experiment 5?
questions.a: R_th_pre = R1 || R2 = 10 kΩ || 10 kΩ = 5 kΩ, so tau_pre = 5 kΩ * 0.25 µF = 1.25 ms.

questions.q: What is the capacitor voltage at t = 20 ms + 50 ms = 70 ms in Experiment 5?
Why must we always include `plt.plot(analysis.time, analysis['output'])` when the user asks to show capacitor voltage?
questions.a: Because requested outputs are explicit requirements; running `.transient()` without extracting and plotting `analysis['output']` leaves the task incomplete.

questions.q: How long after switching (t = 20 ms) does the capacitor take to reach within 1% of -60 V?
questions.a: About 5 time constants: 5 * 50 ms = 250 ms after switching.
